name: Brabant and the Scheldt, c. 1650 (compressed overworld)
frame: metres, x = east, z = south; overworld origin = the ref point (Mechelen)

landcover.encoding: 8-bit palette PNG; pixel (i, j) covers x = origin.x + i*20 .. +20, z = origin.z + j*20 .. +20
landcover.note: sampled from the Ferraris map (1777) through the inverse warp; inside town radii 1:1 (the town files are authoritative there)

warp.description: overworld p -> real q (both in metres around ref). Inside town i (|p - c_i_ow| <= R_i): q = c_i_real + (p - c_i_ow). Elsewhere: q = K*p + D(p), D(p) = sum_i w_i d_i / sum_i w_i, d_i = (c_i_real - K*c_i_ow) - u_i*R_i*(K-1), u_i = (p - c_i_ow)/|p - c_i_ow|, w_i = 1/max(|p - c_i_ow| - R_i, 1)^2. Real metres -> lat/lon: lat = ref.lat - z/110574, lon = ref.lon + x/(cos(ref.lat)*111320).
